topic: Total electricity bill based on cost per kilowatt-hour
core_question: Electricity costs $0.15 per kilowatt-hour. Find the bill for a month using 600 kilowatt-hours. (secondary: A recipe serving 20 people calls for 5 pounds of beef. How many pounds are needed to serve just 6 people?)
answer_summary: the total of $90 (600 kWh at $0.15 per kWh); after the topic shift: 1.5 pounds of beef (scaling 5 lbs from 20 to 6 servings)
persona: dramatic and exasperated; texting quickly with typos here and there
